doc.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07

title: Billie's seven sisters and who read music
summary: She names her sisters, praises Mabel and Sadie at piano, and says she herself plays by ear and does not read.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: The oldest, the two oldest one are there. That's Mabel and Della.

Yeah, Mabel was a great piano player. Mabel was a great piano player. And then, the next great piano player was Sadie. So Sadie, she living in Detroit, Michigan now. But she don't care for it much no more.
She mostly just played for herself and her husband. And they're telling themselves.
Well, what about your mother and father? Did they play by ear or from them?
Your sisters all play by ear or any of them read?
She can play by ear too, I guess.
Yeah, Sadie will play by ear, but she, you know, she's taking music.
And yourself, do you read at all?
